title: Let a named address in through your links

steps.say: This is the exception to the domain rule: one named person, let in by their own address. A supply teacher here for a fortnight, or a colleague who only uses a personal email.
Type the address exactly as they will use it and tap **Add address**. Then send them your usual teacher link.
Without this they can still get in, but they show as **Unverified address** on the Teachers page until they confirm their email. Adding them here first skips that.
steps.terminal: That is a named address let through — the smallest door you can open. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
